spec.description: Lab Core Web Vitals from OnlineTest PostgreSQL (sitespeed_io_test_runs). Device maps to desktop or emulatedMobile. Each page uses its median lab value. Statistic (default p90) aggregates those page values across URLs (min, mean, percentiles, max).

spec.title: Page performance results
spec.description: Lab metrics for pages in the selected group and device. FAIL / WARNING / PASS from LCP, FCP, CLS, TTFB and TBT.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(slug, ''), url)
    url,
    COALESCE(slug, '') AS slug,
    label,
    run_date,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'largestContentfulPaint'->> 'median')::double precision AS lcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'firstContentfulPaint'->> 'median')::double precision AS fcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'pageinfo'->'cumulativeLayoutShift'->> 'median')::double precision AS cls,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'timings'->'ttfb'->> 'median')::double precision AS ttfb,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'totalBlockingTime'->> 'median')::double precision AS tbt
  FROM sitespeed_io_test_runs
  WHERE browsertime_result IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(run_date)
    AND (
      ('${device:raw}' = 'desktop' AND test_type = 'desktop')
      OR ('${device:raw}' = 'mobile' AND test_type = 'emulatedMobile')
    )
    AND (
      '${group:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(slug), ''), 'default') = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${group:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
    AND (
      '${testname:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR url = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${testname:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
  ORDER BY COALESCE(slug, ''), url, run_date DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT
  url,
  CASE
    WHEN label IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(label) ~ '^https?://' THEN BTRIM(label)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS external_link,
  run_date,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(lcp, 0) > 4000
      OR COALESCE(fcp, 0) > 3000
      OR COALESCE(cls, 0) > 0.25
      OR COALESCE(ttfb, 0) > 1800
      OR COALESCE(tbt, 0) > 600
    THEN 0
    WHEN COALESCE(lcp, 0) > 2500
      OR COALESCE(fcp, 0) > 1800
      OR COALESCE(cls, 0) > 0.1
      OR COALESCE(ttfb, 0) > 800
      OR COALESCE(tbt, 0) > 200
    THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END AS status,
  lcp AS lcp_ms,
  fcp AS fcp_ms,
  cls,
  ttfb AS ttfb_ms,
  tbt AS tbt_ms
FROM latest
ORDER BY lcp DESC NULLS LAST

spec.title: LCP (${stat})
spec.description: Statistic across URLs of each page's median lab LCP. min/max are the fastest/slowest pages; p75 is the 75th percentile of pages. Good ≤ 2500 ms, poor > 4000 ms.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (date_trunc('day', run_date), COALESCE(slug, ''), url)
    date_trunc('day', run_date) AS day,
    url,
    COALESCE(slug, '') AS slug,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'largestContentfulPaint'->> 'median')::double precision AS lcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'firstContentfulPaint'->> 'median')::double precision AS fcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'pageinfo'->'cumulativeLayoutShift'->> 'median')::double precision AS cls,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'timings'->'ttfb'->> 'median')::double precision AS ttfb,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'totalBlockingTime'->> 'median')::double precision AS tbt
  FROM sitespeed_io_test_runs
  WHERE browsertime_result IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(run_date)
    AND (
      ('${device:raw}' = 'desktop' AND test_type = 'desktop')
      OR ('${device:raw}' = 'mobile' AND test_type = 'emulatedMobile')
    )
    AND (
      '${group:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(slug), ''), 'default') = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${group:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
    AND (
      '${testname:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR url = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${testname:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
  ORDER BY date_trunc('day', run_date), COALESCE(slug, ''), url, run_date DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT
  day AS time,
  CASE '${stat:raw}'
  WHEN 'min' THEN min_v
  WHEN 'mean' THEN mean_v
  WHEN 'median' THEN median_v
  WHEN 'p10' THEN p10_v
  WHEN 'p75' THEN p75_v
  WHEN 'p90' THEN p90_v
  WHEN 'p99' THEN p99_v
  WHEN 'max' THEN max_v
  ELSE p90_v
END AS "LCP"
FROM (
  SELECT
    day,
    MIN(lcp) AS min_v,
    AVG(lcp) AS mean_v,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lcp) AS median_v,
    percentile_cont(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lcp) AS p10_v,
    percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lcp) AS p75_v,
    percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lcp) AS p90_v,
    percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lcp) AS p99_v,
    MAX(lcp) AS max_v
  FROM latest
  GROUP BY day
) s
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Page status
spec.description: Pages scored PASS / WARNING / FAIL from each URL's median lab LCP, FCP, CLS, TTFB and TBT (same bands as Page performance results).

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(slug, ''), url)
    url,
    COALESCE(slug, '') AS slug,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'largestContentfulPaint'->> 'median')::double precision AS lcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'firstContentfulPaint'->> 'median')::double precision AS fcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'pageinfo'->'cumulativeLayoutShift'->> 'median')::double precision AS cls,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'timings'->'ttfb'->> 'median')::double precision AS ttfb,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'totalBlockingTime'->> 'median')::double precision AS tbt
  FROM sitespeed_io_test_runs
  WHERE browsertime_result IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(run_date)
    AND (
      ('${device:raw}' = 'desktop' AND test_type = 'desktop')
      OR ('${device:raw}' = 'mobile' AND test_type = 'emulatedMobile')
    )
    AND (
      '${group:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(slug), ''), 'default') = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${group:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
    AND (
      '${testname:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR url = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${testname:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
  ORDER BY COALESCE(slug, ''), url, run_date DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 2) AS "Passed",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 1) AS "Warning",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 0) AS "Failed"
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(lcp, 0) > 4000
        OR COALESCE(fcp, 0) > 3000
        OR COALESCE(cls, 0) > 0.25
        OR COALESCE(ttfb, 0) > 1800
        OR COALESCE(tbt, 0) > 600
      THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(lcp, 0) > 2500
        OR COALESCE(fcp, 0) > 1800
        OR COALESCE(cls, 0) > 0.1
        OR COALESCE(ttfb, 0) > 800
        OR COALESCE(tbt, 0) > 200
      THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END AS status
  FROM latest
) scored

spec.title: URLs per metric bucket
spec.description: One row per metric. Counts are the latest run with browsertime JSON in the window, including jobs OnlineTest marked failed. Good: LCP ≤ 2.5 s, FCP ≤ 1.8 s, CLS ≤ 0.1, TTFB ≤ 0.8 s, TBT ≤ 0.2 s.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(slug, ''), url)
    url,
    COALESCE(slug, '') AS slug,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'largestContentfulPaint'->> 'median')::double precision AS lcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'firstContentfulPaint'->> 'median')::double precision AS fcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'pageinfo'->'cumulativeLayoutShift'->> 'median')::double precision AS cls,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'timings'->'ttfb'->> 'median')::double precision AS ttfb,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'totalBlockingTime'->> 'median')::double precision AS tbt
  FROM sitespeed_io_test_runs
  WHERE browsertime_result IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(run_date)
    AND (
      ('${device:raw}' = 'desktop' AND test_type = 'desktop')
      OR ('${device:raw}' = 'mobile' AND test_type = 'emulatedMobile')
    )
    AND (
      '${group:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(slug), ''), 'default') = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${group:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
    AND (
      '${testname:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR url = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${testname:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
  ORDER BY COALESCE(slug, ''), url, run_date DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT metric, good, needs_work, poor,
  100.0 * good / NULLIF(good + needs_work + poor, 0) AS good_pct,
  100.0 * needs_work / NULLIF(good + needs_work + poor, 0) AS needs_work_pct,
  100.0 * poor / NULLIF(good + needs_work + poor, 0) AS poor_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    'LCP' AS metric,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lcp IS NOT NULL AND lcp <= 2500) AS good,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lcp > 2500 AND lcp <= 4000) AS needs_work,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lcp > 4000) AS poor
  FROM latest
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'FCP',
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fcp IS NOT NULL AND fcp <= 1800),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fcp > 1800 AND fcp <= 3000),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fcp > 3000)
  FROM latest
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'CLS',
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cls IS NOT NULL AND cls <= 0.1),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cls > 0.1 AND cls <= 0.25),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cls > 0.25)
  FROM latest
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'TTFB',
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ttfb IS NOT NULL AND ttfb <= 800),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ttfb > 800 AND ttfb <= 1800),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ttfb > 1800)
  FROM latest
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'TBT',
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tbt IS NOT NULL AND tbt <= 200),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tbt > 200 AND tbt <= 600),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tbt > 600)
  FROM latest
) x

spec.title: CWV Group

spec.name: group
spec.label: Group name

spec.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(slug), ''), 'default') AS __text,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(slug), ''), 'default') AS __value
FROM sitespeed_io_test_runs
WHERE browsertime_result IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

spec.name: testname
spec.label: Page URL

spec.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT url AS __text, url AS __value
FROM sitespeed_io_test_runs
WHERE browsertime_result IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    '${group:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
    OR COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(slug), ''), 'default') = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${group:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
  )
ORDER BY 1
